body: Portable Anvil is a lightweight Minecraft Paper/Spigot plugin that allows players to open an anvil anywhere using the /anvil command. Perfect for survival, SMP, hardcore, and PvP servers, it gives quick access to repairing, renaming, and combining items without needing a placed anvil. The plugin includes a simple permission system with anvil.use, customizable permission messages, and full support for Minecraft 1.21.x servers. Easy to install and optimized for performance.
